thread:
Tara: Hey team, opened a compact PR to add a Dedicated provisioning quickstart aimed at small-tenant onboarding. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511
Mike: Nice. very useful. can you include an explicit example showing both scalePolicy and burstPolicy? a lot of customers assume bursts are guaranteed and that causes confusion.
Tara: Agreed. current draft shows a scalePolicy example only. I'll add a tiny burstPolicy YAML and a 2-line SDK example for python.
Sasha: Also add a short Migration note: older configs used 'poolName' and 'priority'; we migrated to 'reservedPools' and 'evictionPriority'. Clarify backwards compatibility window.
Oliver: Good call. Also update the wording about isolation labels. We have three tiers: 'hard', 'soft', 'none' 14 spell out semantics in 1 line each.
doc-bot: FYI handbook canonical SLA URL changed: https://handbook.redwood.ai/dedicated/sla. Update cross-links.
Tara: thanks. draft snippet I'm adding:
Tara: ```yaml
tenant:
  id: 'acme-small'
  reservedPools:
    - 'dedicated-small'
  labels:
    isolation: soft
autoscale:
  scalePolicy: cpu_based
  burstPolicy:
    enabled: true
    maxBurstSeconds: 30
    evictionPriority: low
```
Mike: For SDK example, prefer snake_case and real method names. Minimal python example suggestion:
Mike: ```python
from redwood.dedicated import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.create_tenant(tenant_id='acme-small', reserved_pools=['dedicated-small'], labels={'isolation': 'soft'})
```
Sasha: i'll push a tiny wording fix to the PR to replace 'best-effort' with 'non-guaranteed' in the burst paragraph. Also add this one-liner under SLA: "Reserved SLAs apply only to guaranteed capacity; bursts are non-guaranteed and may be preempted."
Oliver: Can we add a 3-step testing checklist? 1) provision to staging, 2) smoke perf test (~10k tokens/min), 3) lower evictionPriority to verify preemption. Keep each a single line.
Tara: added the checklist and the migration note: "If your configs use poolName or priority, migrate to reservedPools and evictionPriority before v2.1; legacy keys are accepted temporarily."
Mike: Add a cross-ref to the rollouts/fallback docs: recommended fallback is to route to a smaller compatible model or to the shared pool with explicit consent.
Sasha: LGTM. small nit: use active voice for bullets. I'll approve after I push the wording change.
Tara: thanks all 14 i'll make the wording edits, update the handbook link, include the python snippet as shown, and tag for final review. :shipit:
